H: The nested 192-to-384 calibration intervention that repaired the direct teacher mapping in C72E also establishes the -5pp reference safeguard for the full P64-adapted hierarchy and standard compiler at Gaussian sigma .36.

T.dataset: sklearn digits; inherited C10 split_data; train 1077, validation 270; held-out test untouched
T.teacher: exact C68E paired clean/50%-Gaussian-augmented Residual-MLP Net(d=64,depth=4), 60 epochs
T.calibration_recipe: exact C72E nested_calibration_indices and base/extension/validation noise offsets 710100/720101/710200; original base index RNG 20260903, extension index RNG 20260906
T.H64: C61R build_base_hierarchy on robust-teacher clean-training activations; then adapt_anchored to full P64 residual target on shifted calibration, seed+715000, 600 updates
T.S64: C10 compile_final_from_hierarchy(H64), TinyRes(64,32), init seed+716000, fit seed+717000, 600 updates
T.D64: same TinyRes(64,32), initialization and minibatch-index seed, directly fitted to robust-teacher targets; equivalent to C72E width32 cell
T.pairing: one teacher/base hierarchy/shifted validation per model seed; same initial base hierarchy across calibration sizes; exact N192 prefix of N384; same numeric initialization/minibatch seeds
T.bootstrap_method: paired seed percentile 95%; common resampling indices for all cells and contrasts
T.execution_environment: Python3.11, torch2.13.0+cpu, numpy2.4.6, scikit-learn1.9.0, torch threads=1; capture actual versions/build/CPU; no performance benchmark
T.preflight: synthetic evaluator tests; bridge70300 D192/D384 metrics and teacher/data/state hashes must match original C72E implementation in the same environment; fresh seeds prohibited until preflight passes

D.gate: PASS if lower95>margin; FAIL if upper95<margin; otherwise UNCERTAIN. Failure to establish non-inferiority is not evidence of inferiority.
decision_order: any missing, duplicate, ineligible, nonfinite or malformed seed: STOP_INTEGRITY_OR_INCOMPLETE_COHORT
N384_H64 and N384_S64 both PASS: FULL_PIPELINE_REFERENCE_REPAIR
N384_H64 not PASS and N384_S64 PASS: FINAL_VALID_INTERMEDIATE_NOT_ESTABLISHED
N384_H64 PASS and N384_S64 not PASS: COMPILER_REPAIR_NOT_ESTABLISHED
D.descriptive_contrasts: N384-N192 within each stage; D64-S64 and S64-H64 within each size; no multiplicity-corrected mechanistic claim
D.followup: full-pipeline success permits designing a separately locked frontier experiment, not declaring any reduced dimension valid

C: Direct repair may not transfer through hierarchy adaptation or stacked distillation.
A prior binary gate failure may be estimation uncertainty rather than genuine inferiority.
Calibration increase may alter sample coverage, reuse and optimization rather than identify a unique sample-complexity cause.
U: Seed bootstrap is conditional on the fixed digits split and fixed calibration subsets; it does not quantify dataset-sampling uncertainty.
Both calibration sizes already have 76800 draws per 600-update fit; average per-example reuse differs.
Calibration and validation NMSE use different variance denominators: save both raw MSE and denominators and add common-denominator diagnostics.
This is Residual-MLP, not imported Residual CNN or SmallViT; P64 denotes hidden correction dimension, W32 compiler width is a separate variable.
No hardware speed, RAM or energy claim; no test-set evaluation or fresh-cohort selection based on preflight task values.
